title: startup_scan_removes_tmp_files test does not cover the wider *.tmp deletion
description: The test startup_scan_removes_tmp_files creates 'something.msg.tmp' and 'something.env.tmp' — files that both the old and new check would delete. No test covers a file like 'other.tmp' (no double extension), so the behavioral widening in round-6 (extension()=="tmp" matches any .tmp) has zero test coverage. A future contributor who sees the test will believe it demonstrates that only well-formed queue tmp files are deleted, when in fact any .tmp file now matches.
